adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, after a successful parse the helper unconditionally does `if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }`, regardless of whether sync is enabled. This means when an OAuth refresh response omits `refresh_token` (a common behavior), the returned `tokenResponse.data` will now include a literal `refresh_token: "refresh_token"`. In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code merges refreshed fields into the stored credentials via `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`, which will overwrite the previously stored real refresh token with that placeholder string, breaking subsequent refreshes. This overwrite behavior is introduced by the new helper; previously missing `refresh_token` would not be forcibly injected.
